result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.soft_threshold_power()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Evaluate soft-thresholding powers for WGCNA network construction. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L35207-L35280){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.soft_threshold_power( powers=None, r_squared_cutoff=0.8, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Soft-threshold power](/assets/graphs/soft-threshold-power.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="The eight-gene network with a co-expression weight on every edge. Each candidate power raises the weights to that power and fits a scale-free line to the degree distribution; the table lists the signed fit R squared and mean connectivity for powers 1 to 6, rising from -0.35 to 0.93. Power 4 is the first with R squared at least 0.8 (0.90), so it is the recommended power, highlighted in the accent color." width="100%"} For each candidate power β, raises edge weights to |w|^β and checks whether the resulting degree distribution follows a scale-free topology by fitting log(p(k)) ~ log(k). Returns the signed R² (positive when slope is negative, indicating scale-free), the slope, and the mean connectivity at each power. Recommends the lowest power achieving the R² cutoff. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [powers]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[float] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : List of candidate powers to evaluate. Defaults to `[1, 2, ..., 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20]`. [r_squared_cutoff]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.8]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Minimum signed R² to accept a power as adequate. The default is `0.8`. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, return the results as a dictionary. If `False` (the default), return `self` for chaining. The result describes the whole network rather than individual nodes, so it is not written to the node table; the call is only listed by `describe()`. Use `return_dict=True` whenever you need the values. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph | dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A dictionary with keys `powers`, `signed_r_squared`, `slope`, `mean_connectivity`, `r_squared_cutoff`, and `recommended_power` (the lowest power achieving the cutoff, or `None`). ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#f1414983 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph(weighted=True) g.add_nodes(range(20)) import random random.seed(23) for i in range(20): for j in range(i + 1, 20): if random.random() < 0.3: g.add_edge(source=str(i), target=str(j), weight=random.random()) result = g.soft_threshold_power(return_dict=True) result["recommended_power"] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 12.0 ``` ::: :::
